title: Escalation bridge for cross-deployment silent model-drift regressions
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Several customers across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments reported a gradual quality decline after a staged model rollout. Canary thresholds (latency/error) did not trigger automated rollback because the regression presents as 'silent drift'—semantic quality degradation without sharp telemetry anomalies. Goal: define an escalation bridge and an operational pattern to detect, triage, and remediate silent model-drift regressions across deployment modes, minimizing customer disruption while preserving targeted SLOs and data residency constraints.
comments: 2026-01-15 | Asha Patel: Initial report from Customer Ops: multiple tenants flagged reduced answer relevance over ~48h post-rollout. No CPU/GPU spikes, no error rate increase. Assigned to runtime triage.

2026-01-16 | Marco Ruiz: Reproduced with canary prompts — output coherence dropped on long-context prompts. Canary traffic sample size was too small to detect divergence. Proposed: temporary broadened metric set (semantic evals + embedding drift) for future canaries.

2026-01-18 | Lina Gomez (SRE): Ran side-by-side A/B jobs against previous pinned model; baseline performs 12% higher on internal prompt set. Investigating cache/kv differences and quantization parity across Dedicated pools.

2026-01-20 | Marco Ruiz: Deployed emergency config: route affected tenants to variant v1.19-compat for Hosted only, configured Dedicated owners to accept manual routing. Private customers require signed change; notified customer success.

2026-01-24 | Asha Patel: Customer success confirmed interim routing reduced user-visible regressions for 3 major tenants. Still open: formal rollback choreography, automated detection, and private deployment patch process.
2026-02-01 | Marco Ruiz: Drafted escalation-bridge checklist and hotfix PR for runtime kernel parity. Seeking review from Research and Platform Reliability this cycle.
steps_taken: Collected canonical prompt corpus from affected customers and ran nightly large-batch evaluations against current rollout and previous stable model.
Expanded canary telemetry to include embedding cosine drift, ROUGE-like automated semantic checks, and human spot-check flags.
Applied tenant-aware routing to divert affected hosted tenants to pinned stable variant (v1.19-compat) via routing policy override.
Coordinated with Dedicated ops to provide a manual rollback path; issued guidance doc for private customers with checklist for applying the patch and validating binary parity.
Prepared a hotfix branch to restore previous kernel selection and to address a kernel scheduling divergence that appears to exacerbate quantization differences on certain GPUs.
Launched a short-running retrospective with Research to identify why canary sampling missed semantic drift and updated canary sizing recommendations.
decision_log: 2026-01-17: Decision to NOT perform immediate global rollback due to risk of lateral regressions and customer-specific migrations; prefer tenant-scoped mitigations.
2026-01-19: Decision to expand canary metrics to include semantic/eval signals; action assigned to Research to provide a 20k prompt set for canary enrichment.
2026-01-20: Decision to route Hosted affected tenants to stable variant immediately; Dedicated and Private require owner/tenant consent for route change. Documented in routing playbook.
2026-01-25: Decision to create a permanent escalation bridge (this ticket) to codify roles: Incident Lead, Model Owner, SRE, Customer Liaison, and Private Deployment Liaison.
2026-01-30: Agreed rollback criteria for silent drift: >10% drop in customer-specific quality eval over 72h AND corroborating embedding drift in live traffic sample.
2026-01-31: Approved hotfix PR to restore kernel parity for quantized execution; scheduled gated rollout to Dedicated pool after integration tests.
2026-02-01: Decided follow-ups: add post-deploy semantic smoke tests and per-tenant quality thresholds in Console dashboards.
next_actions: Ship hotfix PR to staging and run full integration against Dedicated GPU matrix (NVIDIA A100, H100 non-unified drivers) - owner: Marco Ruiz
Finalize canary enrichment plan with Research and add semantic smoke tests to templated CI for all model rollouts - owner: Priya Shah
Add per-tenant quality thresholds and alerting to Console and create an incident view for escalation bridge - owner: Lina Gomez
Document end-to-end private deployment rollback steps and pre-signed change request template for customers requiring air-gapped approvals - owner: Solutions Eng
Schedule a postmortem and update release criteria to include semantic guardrails before next major rollout - owner: Asha Patel
